bio.jane/contract.noScientificClaim: Reads a sealed run file's bookkeeping; every verdict it reports was computed by run_discovery_programme.
bio.jane/contract.question: What state is a research run in, and what would resuming it do?

description: Read a research run file without running anything: whether its seal holds (an edited or truncated file is refused), every hypothesis's verdict and the rule its evidence was merged by, which hypotheses a resume would run (no evidence, and the last attempt failed or was deferred by a call's budget) and which are settled or canceled, and what resuming would do. Given the corpus, also reports every pinned input whose content changed under the same name, which a resume refuses.

_files.description: The project: record references shaped like _subject. Their records become library documents a tool names in sequences/parts/document; a trace or alignment is found by file name.

_subject.description: The record to act on: exactly one of sequence, accession (+source), sample (an id from list_samples) or file ({name, text} or {name, base64}); record_index picks one record of several.

run.description: the run file run_discovery_programme or resume_research_run returned.

sequences.description: optionally, the corpus as it is now, to check against the run's pinned inputs.

name: research_run_status

decisions.description: every hypothesis's verdict, merged e-value, tests and merge rule

drift.description: pinned inputs whose content changed, when a corpus was given; null when none was

status.description: id, hypothesis counts by verdict, pending and settled hypotheses, and the next action
